source: Trench Crusade Core Rulebook PDF + Warbands of Trench Crusade PDF + Changelog 1.0.2
notes: All entries from this file have been migrated into the isallcaps/trenchcrusadedata fork. This file is kept in place for future patches. Add entries here only for gaps not yet fixed upstream.

description.content: Battlekit that is represented by a model or terrain piece that can be set up during the game.
Add -1 DICE for Melee Attacks targeting a model with this Keyword, or that has a Weapon with this Keyword, if the attacker made a Charge ACTION before making the attack this Turn.
Subtract 3 from the final result of the Injury Roll for attacks against a model with this. A lower result means a less severe injury outcome on the Injury Table.
This model is not affected by the MINED Keyword — it does not detonate mines when moving into contact with them.

INFECTION MARKERS work similarly to BLOOD MARKERS but grow over time. A model may have up to six INFECTION MARKERS at once. They can be spent to modify Success Rolls and Injury Rolls, and combined with BLOOD MARKERS. When a model with INFECTION MARKERS is Activated, place 1 more INFECTION MARKER next to the model before it carries out any Actions. Rules that remove BLOOD MARKERS cannot remove INFECTION MARKERS unless specifically stated.
This model is not affected by the DIFFICULT TERRAIN Keyword — movement across Difficult Terrain does not count as double for this model.

This model ignores the -1 DICE modifier that normally applies when making an attack with an Off-Hand Weapon. The Off-Hand Weapon penalty applies when a model makes a second Melee Attack using Multiple Melee Weapons.

This model ignores the -1 DICE modifier that normally applies when making an attack with an Off-Hand Weapon. The Off-Hand Weapon penalty applies when a model makes a second Melee Attack using Multiple Melee Weapons.
This model is not affected by the DIFFICULT TERRAIN Keyword — movement across Difficult Terrain does not count as double for this model.

eq_bloodcloak.name: Blood Cloak
eq_bloodcloak.blurb: These cloaks are given to the veteran members of the Brigade in recognition for surviving enemy assaults. They make the outline of the warrior hidden in a blood-red haze.

description.content: These cloaks are given to the veteran members of the Brigade in recognition for surviving enemy assaults. They make the outline of the warrior hidden in a blood-red haze.
Blood of Martyrs: Add +2 DICE to Morale checks for your Warband as long as the model carrying the Red Banner is not Down or Out of Action.

Channelled Sorrow: An Atonement Bell can only be used to make an off-hand attack, and moves the target model D3" instead of making an Injury Roll. The move must be in a straight line but can be in any direction, and can be used to make the model Retreat, Climb, Jump across a gap, or Jump Down. An Atonement Bell cannot be used to attack a Retreating model.

Chemical Incense: When deployed, you can declare the model will consume it. If so, until the end of the game the model has NEGATE FEAR and -1 INJURY DICE is added to Injury Rolls for attacks that hit it.
A scavenged shotgun corrupted by the Black Grail. Bayonet Lug, Shield Combo, Limit: 2. 20 Ducats.

ELITE only, Limit: 2. Add +1 INJURY MODIFIER to Injury Rolls for Melee attacks made by the model for each Grail Devotee it has. Each Grail Devotee can be represented by a model placed adjacent to the model that carries them. Grail Devotees are not treated as models for any rules purposes. The cost of the second Grail Devotee taken for a model is paid in Glory instead of Ducats.

Torrent of Bile: When Vomitus is used to make a Ranged Attack, do not make a Success Roll. Instead, measure a straight line 1mm wide and up to 8" long from the attacking model. The line stops if it reaches a terrain piece taller than the attacking model. Make an Injury Roll for every model (friend or foe) touched by the line, apart from the attacking model.
Vile Ferment: Before making Injury Rolls, you may remove 2 INFECTION MARKERS from the Gregori Gula. If you do, add +1 INJURY MODIFIER to Injury Rolls for each model hit.
Great Hunger faction grenade. 15 Ducats. Refer to the Great Hunger supplement for full rule text.

Swinging Blow: When a model armed with a Tenderiser Maul takes a Fight ACTION, you can make 1 Melee Attack against each enemy model within 1" of the attacking model. Resolve each Melee Attack one at a time in the order of your choice.

A War Wolf is armed with two Melee Weapons (Chainsaw Mouth and Shredding Claws). When it makes a Melee Attack it can attack once using either weapon, or twice — first with the Chainsaw Mouth and second with the Shredding Claws (the Off-Hand Weapon modifier applies to the Shredding Claws attack). Both Weapons have the RISKY Keyword so the War Wolf's Activation ends immediately if the Success Roll for either attack is a Failure.
Add +1 DICE to the Risky Success Roll for a War Wolf that is taking a Dash ACTION.

This wicked infernal weapon is treated as a one-handed Ranged weapon with the Keyword BLAST 3". Specify a 1x1mm point on the battlefield within 36" that you want to target that the Witch can see. Next, take a Ranged Attack ACTION. If the roll fails (i.e. you roll 6 or less with the two lowest Dice), the bomb lands 1" away from its intended location, multiplied by the number representing the degree of failure (for example, if you rolled 5, the bomb lands 2" away, as 7-5=2). The direction is decided by your opponent. Roll on the Injury Chart for each model within the BLAST radius.

If the bomb lands exactly on top of any model, roll with 3D6 on the Injury Chart and add the dice together! Other models hit by the Bomb roll on the Injury Chart as standard. Any model hit but not taken Out of Action by this attack is blown D3" directly away from the point of impact (roll for each model separately), stopping if they hit other models/buildings/objects. This attack has the Keyword SHRAPNEL and therefore causes an additional +1 BLOOD MARKER.

Cover, range and higher position do not affect the attacks by the Infernal Bomb. Roll injuries for models in cover/behind intervening terrain with -1 DICE. The Activation of the Witch ends immediately after using the Infernal Bomb.
When you roll the Charge Bonus for a Stosstruppen, roll 1 extra D6 and use the single highest die to determine the bonus.
Up to 2 Stosstruppen in a Stosstruppen of the Free State of Prussia Warband can have the INFILTRATOR Keyword at a cost of +10 Ducats each.
The Stosstruppen or Hauptmann in a Stosstruppen of the Free State of Prussia Warband can have the Rapid Assault ability at a cost of +5 Ducats each.
Add +1 DICE to the Risky Success Roll when a model with this ability takes a Dash ACTION.
Sniper Priests do not use their eyesight to aim at their enemies. The opposing player cannot spend BLOOD MARKERS to add -DICE to a Ranged Attack by a Sniper Priest.

A Sniper Priest can take an Aim ACTION. If they do so, take a Risky Success Roll for the model and add +2 DICE to the roll. If the roll is a Failure, nothing happens and the Sniper Priest's Activation ends. If the roll is a Success or Critical Success, for the rest of the Activation, add +2 DICE to the Success Rolls for Ranged Attacks made by the Sniper Priest.

The Hauptmann orders their warband to stop shooting, forcing the enemy to move first. Pick 1 enemy model in the Hauptmann's Line of Sight that the opponent is allowed to Activate. The Hauptmann's Activation ends, and the opponent must Activate the chosen model next.

Take a Risky Success Roll. On Failure, nothing happens and the Feldkaplan's Activation ends. On Success or Critical Success, place 1 BLESSING MARKER next to the Feldkaplan or a friendly model within 6".
Friendly NEW ANTIOCH models within 8" of a Feldkaplan have the NEGATE FEAR Keyword.
Add +2 DICE to the Risky Success Roll when a Combat Medic uses a Medi-kit for a Treat ACTION.
Add +1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for Melee Attacks made by the Combat Medic if the target is Down and does not have the BLACK GRAIL or DEMONIC Keywords.
Ignore the HEAVY Keyword effect for 1 Satchel Charge the Combat Engineer carries. The model still cannot have more than 1 weapon with the HEAVY Keyword.
Take a Risky Success Roll. On Success or Critical Success, the Combat Engineer has the COVER Keyword until they move from their current position.
A Trench Dog of the Red Brigade cannot be Promoted. Trench Dogs of the Red Brigade are counted as part of the Warband for the purposes of Morale Checks.
Add +1 DICE to rolls for a Trench Dog of the Red Brigade when they Climb, Jump, Fall or take a Dash ACTION.

Trench Dogs of the Red Brigade equipped with Frag Grenades or Molotov Cocktails cannot use them to take a Shoot ACTION. However any friendly non-Trench Dog model can use them to take a Shoot ACTION if they were within 1" of the Trench Dog at any point during their own Activation.

Up to 2 Trench Dogs of the Red Brigade and an equal number of non-Trench Dog models can have the FIRETEAM Keyword at a cost of 5 Ducats each. Each Trench Dog forms a FIRETEAM with one of the non-Trench Dog models. These two FIRETEAMS are in addition to the 2 FIRETEAMS allowed in a New Antioch Warband.

You may give each Trench Dog of the Red Brigade one of the following Abilities at a cost of 5 Ducats: Attack Dog (add +1 DICE to Melee Characteristic); Guard Dog — Limit 1 (models cannot use INFILTRATOR to deploy within 16" of this dog, and it can charge enemy models it cannot see); Mercy Dog — Limit 2 (has and can use a Medi-kit; can drag a friendly Down model within 1" that is more than 1" from any enemy models, halving its Movement Characteristic — cannot drag when retreating or charging).
A Trench Dog of the Red Brigade can make a Melee Attack even though it does not have any Melee Weapons.

Add +1 DICE to the Crimson Communicant's Melee characteristic for each BLOOD MARKER currently placed next to it. In addition, your opponent cannot spend a Crimson Communicant's BLOOD MARKERS to add -DICE to a Success Roll for a Fight ACTION.

If a friendly Matagot Hag within 3" of a friendly Ravenous model is hit by a Ranged Attack or Melee Attack, you can say that the Ravenous will take the hit. If you do so, make an Injury Roll for the Ravenous instead of the Matagot Hag. If the Ranged Attack had the BLAST Keyword, make the Injury Roll for the Matagot Hag before any other models hit by the blast.
Add +1 DICE to Risky Success Rolls for friendly models that are taking a Dash ACTION and are within 8" of the Matagot Hag.

A Matagot Hag can take a Mother's Call ACTION. If it does so, you can remove any number of INFECTION MARKERS from any models (friend or foe) within 18" of the Matagot Hag. For each INFECTION MARKER you remove, you can carry out one of the following Commands with a Ravenous within 8" of the Matagot Hag. A model cannot be given more than 1 Command each Turn, but carrying out a Command does not stop it from also being Activated in the same Turn. Feast Command: the model carries out a Ravenous Infection ACTION and places an additional INFECTION MARKER next to the target on success. Fight Command: the model makes a Melee Attack with +1 DICE to the Success Roll. Follow Command: the model carries out a Move (cannot Charge or Retreat).

A Matagot Hag can make a Melee Attack with the INFECTION MARKERS and CRITICAL Keywords even though she does not have a Melee Weapon. In addition, whenever a Melee Attack made by a Matagot Hag causes any INFECTION MARKERS to be placed on the target, place 1 extra INFECTION MARKER next to the target model.
Add -1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for this model unless the attack has the FIRE Keyword.

A Ravenous can make a Melee Attack with the CRITICAL Keyword even though it does not have a Melee Weapon. In addition, add +1 DICE to the Success Roll for a Melee Attack made by a Ravenous for each other friendly model within 3" of the attacking model (not including the attacking model itself).

A Ravenous can take a Ravenous Infection ACTION. If they do so, take a Risky Success Roll for the model. If the roll is a Failure, the model's Activation ends immediately. If the roll is a Success or a Critical Success, you can place 1 INFECTION MARKER next to any other model within 1" of the model taking the Ravenous Infection ACTION. Then the model's Activation ends immediately.

Once per Turn, when a Gregori Gula would be taken Out of Action, it instead goes dormant. Remove all INFECTION MARKERS from it and replace the model with a 60mm piece of Impassable terrain. The Marker cannot be attacked or targeted by Abilities that interact with Terrain, and does not count as a model. If a friendly Ravenous model finishes a move within 1" of this Marker, remove both the Marker and the Ravenous, and set up the Gregori Gula where the Marker was — it is Down but can be Activated this Turn if it has not already. A dormant Gregori Gula counts as Out of Action for Morale and in the Trauma Step if still dormant at end of battle. The Ravenous that revived it is removed from the Warband Roster.

A Gregori Gula can make a Melee Attack with the +1 INJURY DICE, INFECTION MARKERS and CLEAVE 2 Keywords even though it does not have a Melee Weapon. In addition, if a Gregori Gula made a charge move earlier in the same Activation, replace the CLEAVE 2 Keyword with the CLEAVE 3 Keyword for any Melee Attacks it makes during that Activation.

A Gregori Gula can make a Melee Attack with the +1 INJURY DICE, INFECTION MARKERS and CLEAVE 2 Keywords even though it does not have a Melee Weapon. In addition, if a Gregori Gula made a charge move earlier in the same Activation, replace the CLEAVE 2 Keyword with the CLEAVE 3 Keyword for any Melee Attacks it makes during that Activation.
Add -2 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for a Gregori Gula unless the attack has the FIRE Keyword.
A Gregori Gula can have the Vomitus Ranged Weapon at a cost of 40 Ducats. This weapon cannot be lost or removed during the campaign for any reason.

A model with Devouring Jaws can take a Devour ACTION. If it does so, it can make a Melee Attack against an enemy model within 1". A Devour Melee Attack does not use a Melee Weapon and has the CRITICAL Keyword. If the Devour Melee Attack does not take the targeted model Out of Action, place 1 BLOOD MARKER next to the model taking the Devour ACTION.

A model with Grasping Maw can take a Grasp ACTION. Take a Risky Success Roll. On Failure the model's Activation ends immediately. On Success or Critical Success, pick 1 enemy model within 12" and in Line of Sight. You can move the model 3" in a straight line directly towards the model taking the Grasp ACTION. The move can be used to make the model Jump Down, move within 1" of an enemy or retreat. The model stops if it moves into contact with another model, Difficult, Dangerous or Impassable Terrain, or terrain it cannot cross without Climbing or Jumping.

Ravenous only. A model with the Hellfly Host Strain replaces their Movement Characteristic with 6"/Flying and gains the FLYING Keyword. In addition, a model with the Hellfly Host Strain loses the Undead Fortitude ability.

When an enemy model takes a Retreat ACTION within 1" of a model with the Lockjaw Bite Strain, place 1 INFECTION MARKER next to the model taking the retreat, before any melee attacks are made against the retreating model.

Ravenous and Hounds of the Black Grail only. A model with the Papillal Hide Strain does not need to have Line of Sight to a target when it takes a Charge ACTION. Other charge restrictions still apply.
Matagot Hag and Ravenous only. A model with the Rotten Cutters Strain adds the CLEAVE 2 Keyword to Melee Attacks it makes.
Your opponent cannot spend a Desiccated Husk's INFECTION MARKERS, unless they are converting an Injury Roll into a Bloodbath Roll.

Whenever a Melee Attack made by a Corpse Guard causes any BLOOD MARKERS or INFECTION MARKERS to be placed on the target, you can remove up to 1 BLOOD MARKER or INFECTION MARKER from the attacking Corpse Guard model.
Matagot Hag, Great Maw, Desiccated Husks and Ravenous only. A model with the Unending Starvation Strain adds +1" to their Movement Characteristic.
Treat a Scripture Guardian as having a Movement Characteristic of 3"/Infantry when it takes a Dash ACTION.

A Scripture Guardian can take a Vengeful Scripture ACTION. Pick 1 enemy model within 18" and in Line of Sight. Take a Success Roll with +2 DICE if the enemy is within 9" or +1 DICE otherwise. On Failure, nothing happens. On Success, make an Injury Roll for the enemy model with +1 INJURY MODIFIER for each BLOOD MARKER it has. On Critical Success, make an Injury Roll with IGNORE ARMOUR, +1 INJURY DICE, and +1 INJURY MODIFIER for each BLOOD MARKER the enemy model has.

A Sin Eater can take a Devour the Guilty ACTION. Pick 1 model (friend or foe) within 1" mounted on a base 40mm or smaller. Against an enemy take a Risky Success Roll; against a friendly take a Success Roll with +1 DICE. On Failure, Activation ends if Risky or nothing happens if normal. On Success or Critical Success the model is devoured: place it aside — it cannot act except to Fight the Sin Eater with -3 DICE when Activated. Each time the Sin Eater Activates, place 1 BLOOD MARKER on the devoured model. At 6 BLOOD MARKERS it is taken Out of Action. If the Sin Eater is taken Out of Action, deploy the devoured model within 1" placed Down, or take it Out of Action if impossible. The Sin Eater can take a Purge ACTION (Success Roll +4 DICE) to release the devoured model.

Up to 2 Yeomen can be upgraded to Trench Moles with the INFILTRATOR Keyword at a cost of +10 Ducats each. You can include a 3rd Trench Mole if the total cost of all other models in the Warband adds up to 1,000 Ducats or more.
You can ignore the Effect of the HEAVY Keyword for 1 Melee Weapon that a Shock Trooper has. A Shock Trooper still cannot have more than 1 Weapon of any type with the HEAVY Keyword.

A Combat Engineer can take a Set Mine ACTION if they are in contact with a terrain piece that measures up to 8" by 8" that doesn't have the MINED Keyword. Take a Success Roll with +2 DICE. On Failure nothing happens. On Success or Critical Success the terrain piece gains the MINED Keyword.

When you move a Combat Engineer into contact with a Marker or terrain piece with the MINED Keyword, you can say the Combat Engineer will try to defuse the mine. Take a Risky Success Roll. On Failure the mine detonates. On Success or Critical Success the mine does not detonate and the MINED Keyword is removed. A model that set a mine defuses it automatically.

A War Prophet can take a Loudspeakers ACTION. Take a Risky Success Roll with +2 DICE. On Failure the War Prophet's Activation ends immediately. On Success or Critical Success, move all friendly models within 8" of the War Prophet up to 3" — they must end as close as possible to the nearest enemy model visible at the start of the move. This move can bring a model within 1" of an enemy (counting as charging). If no enemy models are visible they can move normally.

A War Prophet can take a Laying on of Hands ACTION. Take a Success Roll. On Failure nothing happens. On Success remove 1 BLOOD MARKER from a friendly model within 6". On Critical Success remove 3 BLOOD MARKERS instead. The War Prophet can use this ACTION on themselves.
The first time the War Prophet suffers an Out of Action result on the Injury Table, it is treated as a No Effect result instead. A War Prophet cannot have the TOUGH Keyword.

If a friendly PILGRIM model within 1" of a Communicant is hit by a Ranged Attack or Melee Attack, you can say that the Communicant will take the hit. Make an Injury Roll for the Communicant instead of the original target. This ability cannot be used against attacks with the BLAST Keyword.

A Castigator can take an Enforced Orthodoxy ACTION. Take a Risky Success Roll with +1 DICE. On Failure the Castigator's Activation ends immediately. On Success or Critical Success all friendly models within 8" of the Castigator that are Down immediately stand back up at no cost to their movement.

When a Castigator makes a Melee Attack they can target a friendly model within 1" instead of an enemy. Set aside a D6 each time a Castigator attacks a friendly model and takes them Out of Action. The next time the Castigator's Warband takes a Morale Check, each D6 set aside adds +1 DICE to the roll and is then discarded.

If a Trench Pilgrim is killed after a game, they can be resurrected in the following Quartermaster Step as a Martyr Penitent with the Martyr Penitent Profile for a cost of 45 Ducats. Add -1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for a Martyr Penitent. A Martyr Penitent keeps their Battlekit and Zealot Strength if purchased, but loses any Scars, Experience, and Advancements.
Add +1 DICE to Risky Success Roll when this model Climbs, Jumps, makes a Diving Charge, or takes a Dash ACTION.
Each time you remove a BLOOD MARKER from a Stigmatic Nun because of the REGENERATE 1 Keyword, place 1 BLESSING MARKER next to the Stigmatic Nun.
An Ecclesiastic Prisoner that is taken Out of Action when their Martyrdom Device is triggered does not count towards the number of models taken Out of Action for Morale Checks.
An Ecclesiastic Prisoner can make a Melee Attack even though it doesn't have a melee weapon. If it does so, add -1 DICE to the Success Roll for the attack.
Add +1 DICE to the Risky Success Roll for an Ecclesiastic Prisoner that is taking a Dash ACTION.

At the start of each game before deployment, you can say that one Trench Pilgrim or Ecclesiastic Prisoner will be broken on the wheel. The model is permanently removed from your Warband (Battlekit can be redistributed). Injuries that would be inflicted on the Anchorite Shrine are instead inflicted on the victim until they pass away — the Anchorite has Armour 0 and treats Down results as Minor Hit results until the victim dies, after which it gains -3 Armour and the NEGATE SHRAPNEL and TOUGH Keywords.

An Anchorite Shrine is armed with two 1-Handed Melee Weapons (the Catherine Wheel and Bonebreaker Mace). When it makes a Melee Attack it can attack once using either weapon, or twice — first with the Catherine Wheel and second with the Bonebreaker Mace (the Off-Hand Weapon modifier applies to the Bonebreaker Mace attack).
You can make the Yüzbaşı a Janissary Veteran with the STRONG Keyword and the Counter-Charge ability at a cost of +10 Ducats.
If the first ACTION a model makes during their Activation is a Charge, add +1 DICE to Melee Attacks made by the model for the rest of the Activation.
Add +1 INJURY DICE for attacks made by a Yüzbaşı if the target model has the TOUGH Keyword.

When the Jabirean Alchemist is deployed for the first time in a game, give one of the following Keywords to all of its Ranged and Melee Weapons: FIRE, GAS, or SHRAPNEL. All Weapons have the same Keyword. If a Weapon already has the Keyword it does not receive it a second time.

A Jabirean Alchemist can take an Elemental Change ACTION. Take a Risky Success Roll. On Failure nothing happens and the Activation ends. On Success or Critical Success you can change the Mastery of the Elements Keyword on all of the Alchemist's Weapons to one of the other two choices.

After determining the Charge Bonus for a Sultanate Assassin that has not yet made a Fight ACTION this Activation, you can say the Assassin will split itself through time. Choose an additional enemy model as a Charge target (normal rules apply). Make the Charge move to within 1" of the first target and Fight it. After resolving that Fight, immediately remove the Assassin from the battlefield and redeploy it within 1" of the second model, then Fight it. The same Melee Weapon must be used for both attacks. The Assassin cannot take a Fight ACTION later in the same Activation.

If your opponent fails their Success Roll for an attack targeting a Sultanate Assassin, you can say the Assassin will slip into the future. Redeploy it anywhere within 6" of its original location and more than 1" away from any enemy models. If the failed attack took place during a Retreat, the retreat move ends after you redeploy the model.
Any number of Azebs can have the SKIRMISHER Keyword at a cost of +5 Ducats each.
Add -1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for this model.
Enemy models that are Down and mounted on a base of 40mm or less are not allowed to stand up if a Lion of Jabir is within 1" of them, even if the Lion of Jabir is also Down.

This model can take a Trample ACTION. If it does so, it can make a Melee Attack that must target an enemy model that is Down. A Trample Melee Attack does not use a Melee Weapon and has the IGNORE ARMOUR Keyword.
A Takwin Homunculus can make a Melee Attack even though it does not have any Melee Weapons.

If a Takwin Homunculus is killed in the post-battle sequence, you do not have to remove it from your roster. Instead you can spend 40 Ducats in the following Quartermaster Step to leave it on the Roster.
Add -1 DICE to Success Rolls taken for enemy models that are within 8" of one or more Choristers.
Whenever a Melee Attack made by a Lord of Tumours causes any BLOOD MARKERS or INFECTION MARKERS to be placed on the target, place 1 extra INFECTION MARKER next to the target model.

A Lord of Tumours can make a Crushing Blows Melee Attack even if it does not have any Melee Weapons, or instead of using any Melee Weapons it has. If it does so this Melee Attack has the CLEAVE 2 Keyword.

Plague Knights can be given one of the following Ranks — refer to the Cult of the Black Grail special rules in the Warbands of Trench Crusade supplement for the full list of available Ranks and their effects.

A Grail Thrall or Fly Thrall can make a Melee Attack even though it does not have a Melee Weapon. In addition, add +1 DICE to the Success Roll for a Melee Attack made by a Grail Thrall or Fly Thrall for each other friendly model within 3" of the attacking model (not including the attacking model itself).
If an enemy model is Activated while it is within 1" of a Hound of the Black Grail, place 1 INFECTION MARKER next to the enemy model before it carries out any Actions.

Add +1 DICE to the Risky Success Roll for a Hound of the Black Grail that is taking a Dash ACTION. In addition, do not halve the Movement Characteristic of a Hound of the Black Grail when it stands up at the start of an Activation.
Hounds of the Black Grail models can add the INFECTION MARKERS Keyword to their melee attacks at a cost of +5 Ducats each.

A Herald of Beelzebub can make a Melee Attack with the INFECTION MARKERS Keyword even though it does not have a Melee Weapon. If a Melee Attack by a Herald causes any INFECTION MARKERS to be placed on the target, you can remove up to 1 BLOOD MARKER from the attacking Herald.

Up to 1 Herald of Beelzebub can have the Maddening Buzzing ability at a cost of +10 Ducats. Success Rolls taken for enemy models within 8" of a model with this ability become Risky Success Rolls (there is no additional effect if they are already Risky Success Rolls).

An Amalgam can take 1 Shoot ACTION per Activation with each Ranged Weapon it is equipped with, and can take 1 Fight ACTION per Activation with each Melee Weapon it is equipped with. The Off-Hand Weapon modifier does not apply to any of its Melee Attacks.
Add -2 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for any attacks that target an Amalgam model.

Enemy models mounted on a base of 32mm or less are not allowed to make a Melee Attack when an Amalgam within 1" of them retreats. In addition an Amalgam can take a Move or Charge ACTION if all enemy models within 1" of it are mounted on bases of 32mm or less.
A Desecrated Saint can take 1 Fight ACTION per Activation with each Melee Weapon it is equipped with.

A Desecrated Saint has one of the following auras determined by the Deadly Sin its Warband is dedicated to: Aura of Wrath (+1 DICE to Melee Attacks and Dash rolls for friendly models within 8"); Aura of Envy (enemy models within 12" cannot charge a friendly model within 1" of another friendly model); Aura of Lust (negate Armour Keywords for enemy models within 4"); Aura of Pride (place 1 BLOOD MARKER next to each enemy within 8" when Activated); Aura of Sloth (enemy models within 8" treat Minor Hit results as Down results); Aura of Gluttony (-1 DICE to enemy models within 8" without BLACK GRAIL or ARTIFICIAL Keywords); Aura of Greed (enemy models within 12" must charge this Desecrated Saint if able).
A Pit Locust can make a Melee Attack with the CLEAVE 2 and SHRAPNEL Keywords even though it does not have a Melee Weapon.

When a Yoke Fiend is Activated, if it is more than 1" from any enemy models and there is an enemy model within 12" in its Line of Sight without the BLACK GRAIL or DEMONIC Keywords, it must take a Charge ACTION targeting the closest such enemy. If the Yoke Fiend was Down it will stand up if it can and must then attempt the charge.
When a Yoke Fiend makes a Melee Attack it can target a friendly model that does not have the DEMONIC Keyword. If it does so it cannot attack again during the same Activation.

A Stosstruppen Warband can include up to 3 Fireteams. Each Fireteam consists of any two models from the Warband. All models in Fireteams are given the FIRETEAM Keyword at no additional cost. If a model from a Fireteam hits a target that had been hit by the other Fireteam member earlier in the same joint Activation, you can spend 3 BLOOD MARKERS to convert the Injury Roll for the second attack to a Bloodbath Roll, even if the target is not Down.
Add 4" to the Range of all Grenades used by models from a Stosstruppen Warband.
A Red Brigade Warband can include either up to 1 Trench Cleric and up to 1 Sniper Priest, or up to 2 Sniper Priests and no Trench Clerics.

The Lieutenant in a Red Brigade Warband can have the Gunslinger Skill at a cost of 5 Ducats. Models in a Red Brigade Warband can have Molotov Cocktails at a cost of 5 Ducats each and cannot have a Troop Flag.

A Red Brigade Warband can include Trench Dogs of the Red Brigade. The number of Trench Dogs cannot exceed the number of other models in the Warband. The first two Glorious Deeds each battle performed by a Trench Dog that is part of a Red Brigade Warband earns 2 Glory instead of 1 Glory.
A model in a Red Brigade Warband cannot take a Retreat ACTION unless a special rule forces them to do so.

A Red Brigade Warband can skip both the Reinforcement and Exploration Steps in the Campaign Phase in order to recover all the possessions of their models with the NEW ANTIOCH Keyword who died in the Trauma Step of the previous battle. Transfer the Battlekit and Glory Items from these dead models to your Armoury.

A Red Brigade Warband starts each game with 1 BLOOD MARKER for each 200 Ducats of the total Cost of the Warband including Battlekit and upgrades. The opposing player distributes the BLOOD MARKERS between the models after deployment, but cannot give a model 2 BLOOD MARKERS unless all other models have at least 1 BLOOD MARKER each.

At the start of each Turn, choose one of the following effects for your Warband until the end of the Turn. Agonised Churning: when Activating a friendly model within 8" of a Matagot Hag with 2+ INFECTION MARKERS, you can remove 2 INFECTION MARKERS and place them on any enemy within 1" without ARTIFICIAL or DEMONIC. Ruinous Masticating: place 1 INFECTION MARKER on each friendly model within 8" of a Matagot Hag (excluding the Hag); your opponent cannot spend INFECTION MARKERS to add -DICE to Melee Attacks by friendly models with 2+ INFECTION MARKERS. Spasmodic Wretching: place 1 INFECTION MARKER on each friendly model within 8" of a Matagot Hag (excluding the Hag); add -1 DICE to Success Rolls for Ranged Attacks targeting friendly models with 2+ INFECTION MARKERS. Vile Craving: when Activating a friendly model within 8" of a Matagot Hag with 2+ INFECTION MARKERS, you can remove 2 INFECTION MARKERS and move the model up to half its Movement (max 4") directly towards the nearest enemy.

A Great Hunger Warband can have 0-2 Plague Knights on 32mm or 40mm bases with the Ravenous Infection Ability at no extra cost. They can be given one Plague Knight Rank: Butcher King (10 Ducats) — if not Out of Action and has taken at least one enemy Out of Action with a Melee Attack at battle end, gain 1 Glory; Knight Companion of the Feast (5 Ducats) — add +1 DICE to Risky Success Roll for Ravenous Infection ACTION for friendly models within 3"; Knight of Twin Cleavers (5 Ducats) — has IGNORE OFF-HAND Keyword and Melee Attacks have SHRAPNEL Keyword.

A Great Hunger Warband can include 0-3 Cradle Thralls. Cradle Thralls use the Ravenous Warband Entry, do not count towards Maximum Field Strength, have the INFILTRATOR Keyword, and cost 2 Glory to recruit (they do not cost any Ducats).

A Great Hunger Warband can include 0-2 Desiccated Husks. They use the Corpse Guard Warband Entry but their Melee Attacks gain the CRITICAL Keyword, and they replace the Bodyguard Ability with More Worm Than Man: your opponent cannot spend a Desiccated Husk's INFECTION MARKERS unless they are converting an Injury Roll into a Bloodbath Roll.

Models in a Great Hunger Warband cannot have: Beelzebub's Axe, Black Grail Shields, Bolt-Action Rifles, Blunderbusses, Compound Eyes Helmets, Corruption Belchers, Gas Grenades, Infested Rifles, Machine Guns, Musical Instruments, Muskets, Pistols, Troop Flags or Viscera Cannons.

If the total cost of all other models in the Warband adds up to 1,000 Ducats or higher, a Great Hunger Warband may recruit 0-1 Great Maws. A Great Maw uses the Lord of Tumours Warband Entry but does not have the LEADER Keyword.
A Great Hunger Warband must include 1 Matagot Hag. It cannot include a Lord of Tumours, Corpse Guards, Grail Thralls, Heralds of Beelzebub or an Amalgam.

Any model in a Great Hunger Warband can have 1 Strain, except for Ravenous which can have a maximum of 3 Strains. Strains can be purchased upon recruiting a model or during the Quartermaster Step. Once a model has a Strain it cannot be removed or lost for any reason.

A Ravenous can take a Ravenous Infection ACTION. Take a Risky Success Roll. On Failure the model's Activation ends immediately. On Success or Critical Success, place 1 INFECTION MARKER next to any other model within 1" of the model. Then the model's Activation ends immediately.

INFECTION MARKERS work similarly to BLOOD MARKERS but grow over time. A model may have up to six INFECTION MARKERS at once. When a model with INFECTION MARKERS is Activated, place 1 more INFECTION MARKER next to the model before it carries out any Actions. Rules that remove BLOOD MARKERS cannot remove INFECTION MARKERS unless specifically stated.
Rule text sourced from the Cult of the Black Grail faction rules — refer to the Warbands of Trench Crusade supplement for the full Black Grail morale rules.
